lines.text: Peter says that even if believers suffer for what is right, they are blessed and should not fear.
Believers are to sanctify Christ as Lord in their temple and always be ready to explain their hope.
Christ suffered for sins once for all, the righteous for the unrighteous, to bring believers to God.
Christ preached to the spirits in prison who disobeyed in the days of Moses, while the ark was being built.
Baptism now saves believers through the resurrection of Jesus Christ, who is at God's right hand with powers subject to Him.
